purpose: Reject ambiguous scan grouping and timestamp-to-pose association in the private full-bag mapping example before admitting a successful map. Synthetic correctness only; no canonical data run or measured timing qualification.

fixed_contract.message_cardinality: After a selected SQLite topic drains successfully, require collected scan groups to equal its physical message count. Keep existing consecutive raw-header/frame chunk assembly. Cardinality is a necessary admission condition, not a new physical-message identity API or proof of identity. Reject merged identical-header messages and skipped empty messages instead of claiming complete collection.
fixed_contract.topic_timestamps: Before odometry, select both topics from the deterministically sorted episode and require each topic's corrected nanoseconds to be strictly increasing. Reject nonconsecutive repeated raw times and correction-rounding collisions. Equal timestamps across different topics remain valid. Do not deduplicate data, invent timestamps or infer message boundaries from chunk length or chunk sequence.
fixed_contract.pose_binding: Before TSDF allocation/integration, require exactly one trajectory sample per front record and equality of the complete StampedTime, including clock identity/domain/quality. Reject duplicate timestamp keys and mixed topic/frame bindings. Preserve every valid pose and original sensor-to-volume algebra. No silent zip truncation or map overwrite.
fixed_contract.scope: Use safe private example helpers only. Preserve source SHA/path/size, measured calibration admission, actual frame checks, bounded incremental collection, explicit ownership and CPU copies, disk limits and synchronization-window policy. Nearest-neighbor tie/reuse behavior remains deterministic and is not evidence of physical simultaneity. Public source-message identity remains a separate open contract.
fixed_contract.failure: A failed gate cannot produce successful complete/non-truncated mapping output. Existing partial builder state may remain private after a collection error; the overall mapping fails. Do not weaken or fabricate clock/frame/accuracy evidence.
